entry.title: (Low)Code Maturity Model
entry.summary:
TL;DR
The (Low)Code Maturity Model (LCMM) is a framework to classify how a technology team balances governance, flexibility, and delivery speed across three levels: Codeful – Full control over code, strict governance, and strong consistency.
Low-deploy – A hybrid of code and low-code tools, enabling faster delivery while retaining some flexibility.
Low-code – Tool-driven development with minimal coding, ideal for quick wins and non-developer contributions.
Why it matters: Choosing the right level for each initiative helps avoid the extremes of slow, over-governed delivery or uncontrolled, unmaintainable quick hacks. When to use: Codeful → For core systems, high-risk domains, long-term maintainability, improving reusability, refactor of mature features.
